Given the identical article ID, near-identical vote description (unanimous/5-0, 12 months, up to 12-month extension), and the fact that no Sherman Township moratorium is otherwise reported in Ohio press, this is judged to be the same underlying Huron County, Michigan story mis-filed into the Ohio notes (recordpatriot.com covers Michigan's Benzie/Manistee area, not Ohio). It is therefore treated as one instrument, not two, and no separate Benzie County or Ohio candidate is created here.
